ننفرط (form VII)
# نَنْفَرِطُ (nanfariṭu) /nan.fa.ri.tˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْفَرَطَ (infaraṭa)
# نَنْفَرِطَ (nanfariṭa) /nan.fa.ri.tˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَرَطَ (infaraṭa)
# نَنْفَرِطْ (nanfariṭ) /nan.fa.ritˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْفَرَطَ (infaraṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
